text_block_list.text:
October ★ | Noon | Wind: Gusty "Our Secret 
Route" ====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We set our course for the Kikuka Sho. To 
pay Air Shakur back for showing us up with 
his overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
With the Navigator's secret plan and my 
steering at the helm, we'll tear right 
through Air Shakur's logic. The Kikuka Sho 
is as good as ours!
